mapper.select: SELECT usp.id, usp.user_mis, usp.user_org, usp.step_id, usp.completed_at, usp.deleted_flag, usp.create_time, usp.update_time FROM user_step_progress usp INNER JOIN stage_step ss ON usp.step_id = ss.id WHERE usp.user_mis = #{userMis} AND ss.stage_id = #{stageId} AND usp.deleted_flag = 0

SELECT usp.id, usp.user_mis, usp.user_org, usp.user_org_id, usp.step_id, usp.completed_at, usp.deleted_flag, usp.create_time, usp.update_time, ss.stage_id AS stage_id_alias FROM user_step_progress usp INNER JOIN stage_step ss ON usp.step_id = ss.id WHERE usp.user_mis = #{userMis} AND usp.deleted_flag = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_step_progress usp INNER JOIN stage_step ss ON usp.step_id = ss.id WHERE usp.user_mis = #{userMis} AND ss.stage_id = #{stageId} AND usp.deleted_flag = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_step_progress WHERE user_mis = #{userMis} AND step_id = #{stepId} AND deleted_flag = 0

SELECT usp.user_mis AS userMis, ss.stage_id AS stageId, MAX(usp.completed_at) AS lastActiveAt FROM user_step_progress usp INNER JOIN stage_step ss ON usp.step_id = ss.id WHERE usp.deleted_flag = 0 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM user_stage_progress usgp WHERE usgp.user_mis = usp.user_mis AND usgp.stage_id = ss.stage_id AND usgp.verify_status = 'passed' AND usgp.deleted_flag = 0 ) GROUP BY usp.user_mis, ss.stage_id ORDER BY lastActiveAt DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT DISTINCT user_mis FROM user_step_progress WHERE (user_org = '' OR user_org IS NULL) AND deleted_flag = 0 ORDER BY user_mis LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT DISTINCT user_mis FROM user_step_progress WHERE (user_org_id = '' OR user_org_id IS NULL) AND deleted_flag = 0 ORDER BY user_mis LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE user_step_progress SET user_org = #{userOrg} WHERE user_mis = #{userMis} AND (user_org = '' OR user_org IS NULL) AND deleted_flag = 0
UPDATE user_step_progress SET user_org_id = #{userOrgId} WHERE user_mis = #{userMis} AND (user_org_id = '' OR user_org_id IS NULL) AND deleted_flag = 0
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_mis) FROM user_step_progress WHERE (user_org = '' OR user_org IS NULL) AND deleted_flag = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO user_step_progress (user_mis, user_org, user_org_id, step_id) VALUES (#{userMis}, #{userOrg}, #{userOrgId}, #{stepId})
